findings.title: A runtime 500 on the API core path discards its own cause
findings.reason: apps/api-server/src/server.ts builds Fastify with logger: false, which the installed fastify logger factory maps to a no-op abstract logger, so every server.log call discards its record; the x-request-id header is emitted but never logged, so no server-side record joins a failing request to its cause; two 500 paths collapse distinct errors into a bare {error: "auth_failed"} while one leg string-sniffs the error message to choose 409 versus 422 and returns it to the client; and a failed startup exits non-zero after a no-op log call. The e2e layer proves what an endpoint returns but cannot show why it failed, blocking the diagnose step of the failure-repair loop on the path AGENTS.md declares most sensitive. Uncertainty: verified for the focused-test profile only; a deployment-layer log sink outside the repo may exist and is exactly what the no-op logger would then rely on.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Restore a readable diagnostic route on the API core path: configure a Fastify logger (level and redaction for auth fields) or a small logging facade in apps/api-server/src/server.ts, log the request id on error, preserve the caught cause on the 500 paths instead of discarding it, and replace the message-sniffing status choice with typed error classes.

## Validation

- The tests/e2e run still passes
- A forced failing request yields a readable, request-id-correlated server log line
expectedOutput: Update the existing Code owner identified by the reviewed evidence and retain a focused validation result.
